craft_notes: Sthāyin: svādhyāya-vīra of study-and-making — hermetic couplets, hyphen-pressure; music in pack + terminal words; FIRST VERSE of the work sets the house voice (owner verdict required). God-made gods; goddess being-nonbeing-made — of-Him-made anaphora ×2 (row 9). Rejected: (a) trimming second made → killed: doubling is the making. (b) Bhairavī→goddess gloss → killed: name load-bearing. Read aloud: HE, BHAI-ra-va-GOD in-DEED … SHE, BHAI-ra-VĪ …

lines: He, Bhairava god indeed — all gods, of-Him-made;
she, Bhairavī — being, non-being too, of-Him-made.
l4.sanskrit_cite: sa eva bhairavo devas sarve devāś ca yanmayāḥ | saivāsau bhairavī sattāsattāpi ca yanmayī
